item.title: WATCH- Abhishek Sharma trains in nets after joining Punjab squad for upcoming VHT 2025-26 matches
item.description: With a training session in Jaipur, Abhishek Sharma has started preparing for the forthcoming Vijay Hazare Trophy, demonstrating his intention to contribute in ways other than batting. A day before Punjab's match against Uttarakhand, Abhishek was spotted bowling at a practice session at the Anantam Cricket Ground on the outskirts of Jaipur. item.title: Ashes 2025-26: “No fluke”- Geoff Boycott says England played better cricket than Australia to win; slams modern day batters
item.description: Legendary opener Geoffrey Boycott did not see England's Boxing Day Test victory as a fairytale. Instead, he offered it as a clear judgment on how the game is currently being played, which he believes is incorrect. On a spicy pitch in Melbourne, England won the toss and opted to bowl first and reaped huge rewards as Australia was bowled out for 152 runs as Josh Tongue took 5/45. item.title: Shreyas Iyer set to feature in New Zealand ODIs, likely to play two Vijay Hazare Trophy games for Mumbai next week: Report
item.description: India batter Shreyas Iyer has stepped up his return to cricket as he resumed training in the nets and reported to the BCCI Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bengaluru ahead of the New Zealand ODI series, slated to begin on January 11 in Vadodara. item.title: ‘Third party intended to marry my husband’- Sannia Ashfaq and Imad Wasim announce divorce after 6 years of marriage
item.description: Former Pakistan all-rounder Imad Wasim on Sunday announced his divorce after more than six years of marriage to Sannia Ashfaq. The couple tied the knot in 2019 and have three children. Wasim claimed that the decision resulted from unsolved issues, with him and Sannia choosing a mutual divorce following longstanding disagreements that could not be settled. item.title: Yashasvi Jaiswal to join Mumbai squad ahead of their VHT 2025-26 game against Goa, confirms MCA Secretary Unmesh Khanvilkar
item.description: Talented young opener Yashasvi Jaiswal is set to join the Mumbai squad ahead of their Vijay Hazare Trophy (VHT 2025-26) clash against Goa on December 31. This was confirmed by Mumbai Cricket Association (MCA) Secretary Unmesh Khanvilkar. item.title: IND v NZ 2026: Jasprit Bumrah, Hardik Pandya unlikely to feature in ODI series against New Zealand - Report
item.description: India’s pace spearhead Jasprit Bumrah and star all-rounder Hardik Pandya are unlikely to feature in the upcoming three-ODI series against New Zealand, Cricbuzz reported. However, both of them are expected to return for the five T20Is against the Kiwis that follows the 50-over series. item.title: Ashes 2025-26: “The ‘ares’ do not agree with the ‘has-beens’ here,” Sunil Gavaskar takes brutal swipe at Ben Stokes
item.description: The Ben Stokes-led England side arrived in Australia with a lot of expectations, but ended up conceding the Ashes urn in just 11 days -- the joint-second quickest in more than a century. The visitors had just one warm-up fixture in Australia, against their second-tier Lions side, and lost the opening Test in Perth inside two days.
